visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair tied up, wearing a white sleeveless crop top and grey high-waisted leggings, sits on a white-padded Pilates machine. She holds a small pink ball with both hands above her head in a bright studio with mirrored walls and wooden lattice screens. (2) On an outdoor street near modern buildings, the woman holds a large black umbrella. She is dressed in a light cream top with a white leather backpack, looking back towards the camera with a cheerful, squinted-eye smile. (3) In a home setting, she sits cross-legged on a carpet wearing a cream hoodie and a yellow character headband. She is meticulously sorting through several transparent plastic makeup organizers filled with colorful cosmetic tubes and brushes. (4) The camera focuses closely on her face in a room with a bed and white pillows. She holds a green circular mirror and carefully applies makeup to her cheek using a small brush, showing focused facial expressions. (5) A close-up displays a dark grey container overflowing with a variety of used makeup brushes, showing visible residue on the bristles. The background is a plain, light-colored desk surface in a neutral environment. (6) In a modern white bathroom, she presents a square blue box with a cartoon fish character illustration. She opens the box to reveal organized compartments containing brushes, stickers, and a round glass jar with a blue lid. (7) A high-angle close-up shows the jar opened, containing several mint-green, crystalline-textured cleaning beads shaped like small pillars. The lighting is bright and white, reflecting off the glass jar and the clean countertop. (8) Her hands are shown over a white ceramic sink under a stream of clear water from a silver faucet. She swirls a makeup brush and then a blue makeup sponge against the green beads in the jar, creating white soapy lather.

The BGM remains constant in volume and tempo, providing a cheerful atmosphere. The BGM maintains its bright, major-key tonality throughout the sequence without any pause. (4) The sound of a water faucet turning on creates a continuous splashing and running water noise floor. This is layered with the rhythmic, wet friction sounds of bristles being rubbed against a hard surface and soapy lather. (5) A soft, squishing sound of a wet sponge being compressed is heard repeatedly, synchronized with the running water. The female voice maintains a professional yet casual narrative style, clearly enunciating each word over the background sounds. (6) The water splashing sound stops abruptly. The female voice reaches a concluding inflection with a rising pitch, and the upbeat acoustic BGM swells slightly before fading out into studio silence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote a makeup brush cleaning soap by MOODY, specifically a collaboration with the character Hangyodon. It targets 'Type P' (spontaneous/unorganized) individuals who struggle with the chore of cleaning brushes, presenting the product as an easy and aesthetically pleasing solution.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of the MOODY product box and jar, detailed demonstration of its use, and vocal praise of the product.
